summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing the upcoming release of its H1 2026 interim report and earnings presentation on 25 August 2026. CEO Mikkel Gleerup and CFO Peter Brogaard Hansen will present live via webcast. This is a routine earnings notification with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tenders, or restructuring. The filing simply informs investors of the disclosure date and access details, with no deal terms or strategic actions. The appropriate classification is None, as it is an ordinary current report.
